d: Long, wavy honey-blonde hair with blunt bangs frames a face of young adult maturity, featuring sharp blue eyes. The build is broad and stately, draped in an ornate royal ensemble consisting of a cream-colored gown with a central deep blue panel, accented by gold filigree and a large golden starburst emblem at the waist. Heavy gold pauldrons with white fur trim sit atop the shoulders, complemented by a flowing blue cape with gold embroidery and a matching golden crown atop the head. A tall, golden ceremonial scepter is held in the right hand.
